$comment: Authority for public conversation-settings keys that cross the browser boundary. Edit this file first. lib/conversation_sync/settings_policy.py derives the catalog projection; frontend/src/api/conversation-settings-contract.ts derives the browser cache set. tests/conversation/test_conversation_settings_contract.py and frontend/src/conversation/application/conversation-settings-contract.test.ts prove every hand-written writer, normalizer and adopter matches it.
scope: Keys the browser writes, adopts, caches, or receives in the catalog. Server-internal keys (cache tracking, Goal pins, paper source lists, coordinator idempotency) stay owned by their modules and are inert in the browser. Private keys are defined by lib/conversation_sync/settings_policy.py and never leave the server.

authors.composer: Browser composer state. buildConversationSettingsSnapshot sends it, resolve_conv_settings normalizes and persists it, and _applySettingsToConv adopts it back, so reloads restore the user's choice.
authors.composer-derived: Recomputed by the browser from ambient state on every write. The server persists it; the browser never adopts it back.
authors.resolver-derived: Computed by resolve_conv_settings on every browser write. The browser neither sends nor adopts it under its own name.
authors.server: Written only by the listed server owners. The browser adopts it but never writes it through the settings snapshot.
authors.legacy: No current producer. Read only so stored values from older releases keep working or can be migrated.

fields.adopt: _applySettingsToConv maps the key onto the in-memory conversation.
fields.catalog: The sidebar catalog projection (GET /api/v4/conversations) carries the key. Catalog keys must be adopted.
fields.cache: The browser IndexedDB metadata cache persists the adopted value. Cache keys must be adopted.
fields.clearWhenAbsent: Full settings are authoritative: absence clears the adopted value. Partial projections such as the catalog never clear it.
fields.readAliases: Ordered fallback keys read when the canonical key is empty.
fields.owners: Repository files that write a server-authored key.
